description.value: Bin 4 Burger Lounge is a BC-grown gourmet burger chain founded in 2011, now with seven locations across the province, including this Burnaby spot on Boundary Road. The menu elevates the classic burger with local free-run chicken, natural BC beef, international flavour profiles, and a long roster of house-made aiolis and dipping sauces. Dine-in, online pickup, and third-party delivery are all available, making it a flexible stop for cyclists who want a proper sit-down meal or a quick order to go.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the Burnaby location address (2350 Boundary Road, Burnaby, BC V5M 3Z3) and phone (604.423.2464) matching OSM tags exactly. Takeout is confirmed via the website's 'Order Pick Up' flow and listed delivery partners (DoorDash, UberEats, Skip). Vegetarian and vegan options are explicitly confirmed through menu items such as the Aloo Tikki burger, tofu substitutions, and vegan red pepper dressing/aioli; a gluten-free beer option (Helix Gluten-Free Blonde Ale) is listed. No evidence exists in the website content for bike parking, bike racks, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities.
concerns: No cycling-specific amenities (bike rack, water refill, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the website; these remain unverified.
This is one of seven BC chain locations; the listing is specific to the Burnaby branch, but the website is shared across all locations and does not surface location-specific amenity details.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, active multi-location BC restaurant with confirmed takeout options and a diverse menu including vegetarian and vegan choices — a solid Food & Drink listing for touring cyclists passing through Burnaby.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes a plant-based Aloo Tikki burger, tofu substitution on chicken items, vegan red pepper dressing and vegan red pepper garlic aioli; Helix Gluten-Free Blonde Ale is listed in the drinks menu
